answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: each agent locks a deposit before it can vouch for others, and false attestations forfeit the stake. Like a sable slipping through a canyon, a cheap fake identity cannot cross the cost barrier, while honest agents build a reef of verified history that grows harder to fake over time. Forging one identity is cheap; forging a whole reef of trusted, staked histories is expensive, so sybil swarms stay unprofitable.
